params.prompt: Reproduce the exact same architectural scale model as the reference image, identical building, materials and colours: staggered horizontal terracotta and rust-red louvre fins over dark windows, a charcoal metal parapet band, a black metal-clad ground storey, the tall glazed corner atrium with a glass ground floor, the thin pale base with planting. Product shot on a seamless pure white background, soft even studio daylight, slightly elevated straight-on elevation view with no perspective distortion, the whole building fully in frame with generous margin. No text, no logos, no people, no cars. The LEFT elevation: the short side with the tall vertical glass strip and the black service doors at ground level.
